newsitem.title: USA: NYS Thruway sets $350 mln bond sale for next week.
newsitem.headline: NYS Thruway sets $350 mln bond sale for next week.

text.p: The New York State Thruway Authority plans to sell next week around $350 million of general revenue bonds through a syndicate led by Dillon, Read, the underwriting firm said on Monday.

Moody's Investors Service earlier said it upgraded the Authority's revenue bonds to Aa3 from A1 in part because of the strength of the agency's financial performance and planning and its continued operational autonomy from the state.
The rating agency said that with the sale, the Authority will have about $1.2 billion of general revenue bonds outstanding.
